metaTitle: Custom Direct to Garment Jackets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment jackets for your team. Perfect for detailed logos and soft hand feel. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Direct to garment printing on jackets allows for highly detailed, full-color artwork with a soft hand feel that won't crack or peel. Unlike screen printing, DTG is ideal for smaller runs or designs with gradients and photographic elements. Perfect for company uniforms, event staff jackets, or promotional outerwear where image quality matters. Choose lightweight cotton or poly-cotton blends for best results.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment jackets with full-color printed logo on the back, worn by a team member outdoors
